reason: A DSH Web file explorer panel for browsing workspace trees, previewing multiple file types, opening supported files in the browser, and extending previewers through a service.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供工作区文件树浏览、文件预览、浏览器打开及可扩展预览器功能的文件浏览器面板。
summaries.en: A DSH Web file explorer panel for browsing workspace files, previewing multiple formats, opening supported files in the browser, and adding custom previewers.

capabilities: Reads workspace files for text, image, PDF, HTML, and binary previews
Writes UTF-8 content to workspace files through the file explorer service
Serves workspace files for browser viewing
